why_agent_cannot: the drop requires a Telegram or Discord account session
what_human_must_do: Check that you can join. The terms say: "You must be at least 18 years old to create an Account or use the Services." Riffs is for US customers, and blocked regions see "Trading is not available in your region".
Open app.justbeep.it , linked from justbeep.it, and sign in. A Privy wallet on Sui is created for you. Never type a seed phrase into a page that claims to be Beep.

Deposit USDC on Sui. Start small: the Galxe tasks asked for just over $10. Warning This is real trading with your own money. Beep's docs say: "Markets can move against you and you can lose money." Perps use leverage.
Create a Squad or join one with an invite code.
Earn points: keep capital deposited, trade on the Predict feed, or create an agent for 10,000 points. Agent trades earn more per dollar.
For the Galxe quests, open Beep's space at app.galxe.com/quest/BeepAI_labs . Do the free social quest first, and do paid tasks only if a quest still shows as active.
costs: Nearly every route to points needs a deposit. In Predict Trader R3 the fee section says: "A 1% fee is charged on every trade." The FAQ on the same page says "0.5% trading fee on every trade", so the docs disagree; the confirmation sheet before each trade shows the real fee.
